label: Seamless Pattern
description: A tileable repeat for textile, wrapping or a background — the test is that the eye cannot find the seam or the grid.
prefix: A seamless repeating pattern, tileable in every direction
suffix: a true seamless repeat: motifs continue across every edge and meet perfectly, even visual density with no obvious grid or rivers, flat even lighting across the whole tile
negative: visible seam, cropped motif at the edge, vignette, perspective, drop shadow, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
